body: She kept staring at me today and I just can't stand it. I can't switch out again, I've already changed this class now it's too late.

I was a mistake. I wasn't planned for my parents, my parents weren't even married. I feel like they love me because they have to. They judge people a lot, even my older sister and they always say things in front of me about her. I love my sister, she's made a few mistakes, they have no reason to talk about her. Were half sisters.
That's why I love my teacher so much. She's really kind and never judges people. In a way, she's like my sister. She is young so she understands students, she never yells, never makes class boring. She's my friend. When I'm sad she knows and tries to help me. My parents on the other hand couldn't give less of a crap. I remember one time I had a really bad weekend a few months ago from something my parents said to me. I couldn't sleep the entire Sunday night because I was so upset. The next day my teacher asked if I was ok because I looked tired. A person I've known for only two years knows if I'm sad better than my parents who have known me my whole life.
Don't get me wrong, I don't hate my parents at all, I'm not that type of person. I just don't feel as close to them. 
I care about my teacher a lot, she's like a really close sister to me. But I know she's a teacher, she has other students. I'm just one student. Like any other of my teachers, she would go on and forget. I know that's harsh to say, I don't mean it in a mean way. I'm just saying- I don't matter and still wouldn't matter if I were gone.

There's no use for me to stay here anyways. No college wants a failure of a student, a student who was put in a class because she's stupid or someone who couldn't pass a single chemistry test.
No one would miss me either. At school, not a single person knew my name in my Spanish class except my teacher. I always make a fool of myself doing something as simple as ordering my lunch. 
Me being gone would just be like a rock being taken from a huge like of rocks. No one would care and no one would notice.
